I answered Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is **Thea Ramaswell** at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

This comes from #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, a channel Marcus is in. Dana posted that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. One trailer showed up as two rows because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch also added him by hand. Dana said they would look into it.

That same message also gave the account's seat count, which isn't relevant to the question, so I left it out of the reply.
